summary.critical_finding: 3 out of 4 server models fail integrity verification on disk (1 SHA256 mismatch, 2 synthetic fragment URI pointers to non-existent files). On the client side, the primary edge ONNX model does not exist on disk, and client workers are non-existent architectural scaffolds.

models.name: Universal Garment Classifier & Multi-Task Taxonomy Engine
models.claimed_purpose: Hierarchical multi-head classification across 10 top categories and 55 subcategories with component presence verification.

client_profile.notes: UnifiedAIOrchestrator.executeEdgeClassification returns a hardcoded mock object instead of executing this model.

models.name: Human Pose & Keypoint Alignment Estimator
models.claimed_purpose: 33 full-body anatomical landmark tracking for garment scale, shoulder span, and perspective alignment.

server_profile.notes: Calculated SHA256 does not match recorded registry checksum.

client_profile.notes: Frontend relies on external CDN fetch. MediaPipe adapter exists as an uncalled scaffold in PhotoTo3DGarmentModal.tsx.

models.name: High-Fidelity Garment Boundary & Foreground Segmenter
models.claimed_purpose: Accurate clothing extraction separating garment from human skin, hair, and complex background scenes.

server_profile.notes: The registry points to a URI fragment inside models/registry.json (a 2.8KB JSON metadata file), not an actual 142MB ONNX model file.

client_profile.notes: No Web Worker file exists in the repository. Canvas 2D processing executes entirely on the main UI thread.
